issues.issue: Must the applicant pay the respondents' costs of the four extension-of-time motions under Rule 410(2), regardless of outcome?
issues.applicant_position: Rule 410(2) does not apply: motions also sought other relief, and orders were silent on costs.
issues.respondent_position: Rule 410(2) is mandatory: the applicant must pay respondents' costs of all four extension motions regardless of outcome.
issues.result_quote: I disallow the Respondents' costs as they relate to the four motions

issues.issue: What amount of the respondents' bill of costs is allowed (application record, paralegal, assessment, disbursements)?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant offered a nominal $300 in total and says nothing should be allowed for item 2.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents claimed $9,487.85 in costs, citing the applicant's delay tactics and excessive work.
issues.result_quote: The Respondents' bill of costs, presented at $9,487.85, is assessed and allowed at $1,239.80.

issues.issue: Should the applicant recover its own costs of the assessment (Rule 408(3)) instead of respondents getting item 26 costs?
issues.applicant_position: Assessment was unnecessary, so respondents should not get item 26 costs; applicant should get $434.60.
issues.result_quote: I allow item 26 (assessment of costs) as presented at the maximum 6 units
